sample_unit: queries per AI tool (LAIA initiation and missed-dose dosing scenarios)

links.outcome: Accuracy of AI dosing recommendations for long-acting injectable antipsychotics initiation and missed doses
links.effect: OpenEvidence 95% accurate (one inaccurate response); ChatGPT 40% accurate; 62% of inaccuracies occurred in missed-dose scenarios.
links.quote: OpenEvidence was the most accurate, providing an inacurate response to only one query (a 95% accuracy rate). ChatGPT was the least accurate, with a 40% accuracy rate.

links.outcome: Incorrect AI dosing outputs that clinicians might act on without verification
links.effect: Accuracy varied significantly across tools; ChatGPT 40% accurate; most inaccuracies (62%) in missed-dose scenarios, supporting need to verify against package inserts.
links.quote: Most of the inaccuracies (62%) occurred when the AI tools provided recommendations related to missed-dose scenarios.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four generative AI tools answering clinical queries regarding dosing recommendations for long-acting injectable antipsychotics without comparing an operational safeguard or deployment practice.
